notes: Every threshold in targets[] is transcribed verbatim from the Ticket 13 resolved answer (NFR round 1 + round 2).
Do not lower a target to make a run pass. A profile that does not declare claimsTarget=true can only ever report MEASURED / NOT_MEASURED / ENV_GATED - never PASS.

The Quote/Confirm/payment mix and the pre-cutoff burst shape are NOT fixed by Ticket 13; the numbers below are this harness's declared scenario identity (harness decision, must be stated in every report).

mix.quotes_per_second_to_confirms_per_second: 2:1 (2 Quotes issued per 1 Confirm, i.e. the Quote -> Order -> Confirm funnel re-quotes on half of its attempts)
mix.confirm_is_explicit_command: POST /api/v1/member/orders/:id/confirm with Idempotency-Key and expected version

burst.description: realistic pre-cutoff burst: steady phase, then a linear ramp to peak inside the last burstWindowSeconds before Draw cutoff, held until cutoff

dataset.members: one active, KYC-verified, terms-accepted, profile-complete Member per concurrent session
dataset.wallet: each Member funded in the CASH bucket with enough minor units for its whole session's stake volume
dataset.draws: one OPEN Draw per product with cutoff far in the future for steady-state scenarios; a dedicated Draw whose cutoff is placed burst_window_seconds ahead for the pre-cutoff burst scenario
dataset.settlement: N confirmed Bet Orders, each with at least one Bet Line, on a Draw that has a CONFIRMED Result revision

payment_webhook_events_per_second.verbatim: at least 200 payment/webhook events/second under production-like tests

read_api_latency.verbatim: ordinary read APIs target p95 <= 300 ms and p99 <= 800 ms

quote_latency.verbatim: Quote targets p95 <= 500 ms and p99 <= 1.5 s

confirm_latency.verbatim: Confirm targets p95 <= 800 ms and p99 <= 2 s

critical_server_error_rate.verbatim: Critical API server error rate must remain below 0.5%

critical_queue_lag.verbatim: critical Outbox/queue delivery targets p95 < 5 s under normal operation, with alerting if critical lag exceeds 30 seconds

settlement_capacity.verbatim: at least 100,000 Bet Lines within 10 minutes for the configured worker pool; failures must resume idempotently and partial completion is never Member-visible

duplicate_financial_effect_under_load.verbatim: no critical business or financial effect may duplicate under load

smoke.purpose: harness plumbing proof: exercises every driver against a real API and emits the report shape. Never capacity evidence.

sandbox.purpose: largest run that is honest on a single co-located 2 vCPU host. Reported as MEASURED, never PASS.

target.purpose: the Ticket 13 acceptance run. Requires a production-like environment (see docs/implementation/load-harness-scenario-and-environment.md).

requiredObservability.note: The harness will not scrape logs to fake an SLO. Each signal must be read from the API/worker metrics surface. A missing family is reported as NOT_MEASURED with the observed metric-family inventory.
